findings.issue: parse_track returned Ok(tick) when the while at < data.len() loop reached the end of an MTrk chunk without ever encountering a mandatory End-of-Track (FF 2F) meta event.

read_cell returned unpacked cells (flag & 0x80 == 0) without clamping out-of-range notes > NOTE_KEY_OFF (97) to 0, violating the packed/unpacked cell equivalence invariant; parse_patterns passed the full file slice to read_cell and only checked cursor > end after reading a cell; and parse_instruments accepted 16-bit samples (SAMPLE_FLAG_16_BIT) with odd data_bytes, silently dropping the trailing byte in decode_delta_16.
SmfAudioReader::present_decoded and XmAudioReader::present_decoded did not reject negative source_pts or unaligned PCM frame payloads (packet.data.len() % (CHANNELS * 4) != 0).
